feed.title: Several projects to make merchant adoption easier and cheaper

entry.title: Several projects to make merchant adoption easier and cheaper
entry.summary:
Merchant onboarding to Lightning payments often presents significant challenges, leading many to abandon the process due to technical complexities. A critical consideration in this setup is the scenario where a merchant's Electrum wallet is offline during a customer's payment attempt via CLINK.
When such an incident occurs, the customer may encounter a failed payment since the Electrum wallet, being offline, cannot receive or process incoming transactions through Lightning. This situation raises concerns about the reliability and user experience of Lightning-based payment systems in real-world merchant environments.
To improve resilience and ensure seamless transactions even when the primary Lightning wallet is inaccessible, potential solutions could include automatic fallback mechanisms. These might involve redirecting the payment to an on-chain Bitcoin address or integrating with alternative payment options such as a cashu mint. Implementing such features would enhance the robustness of the merchant payment flow and reduce friction for both merchants and customers.
